description.zh:
备份客户端ID。

> 调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the backup client.

> You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
The ID of the server instance.

description.zh:
云安全中心实例地域。取值为：

- **cn-hangzhou：**  杭州
- **ap-southeast-1：**  新加坡
- **cn-beijing：**  北京
description.en:
The region of the Security Center instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: China (Hangzhou).
- **ap-southeast-1**: Singapore.
- **cn-beijing**: China (Beijing).

description.zh:
需要删除的快照ID。
>调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the snapshot to delete.
>You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：

- **ECS_FILE**：ECS文件的备份快照。
- **OSS**：阿里云OSS的备份快照。
- **NAS**：阿里云NAS的备份快照。
- **OTS_TABLE**：阿里云表格存储的备份快照。
description.en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- **ECS_FILE**: backup snapshot of ECS files.
- **OSS**: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud OSS.
- **NAS**: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud NAS.
- **OTS_TABLE**: backup snapshot of Alibaba Cloud Tablestore.

description.zh:
恢复任务的备份仓库ID。
>调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the backup vault for the restoration task.
>You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
是否保留最新快照。
- **true**：是
- **false**：否
description.en:
Specifies whether to retain the latest snapshot. Valid values:
- **true**: retains the latest snapshot.
- **false**: does not retain the latest snapshot.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas delete-backup-snapshot --retain-latest-snapshot true --backup-snapshot-list SnapshotId=s-000f9p6r5trm6u4d0000 InstanceId=i-j6cj8vyajp1fo4at0000 SourceType=ECS_FILE ClientId=c-000a4h33w14ka8xa0000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou VaultId=v-0004vhwcs2pmacfz0000 --backup-region-id-list cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DeleteBackupSnapshot --region cn-hangzhou --BackupSnapshotList.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --BackupRegionIdList.1 'cn-hangzhou' --BackupSnapshotList.1.SourceType ECS_FILE --BackupSnapshotList.1.InstanceId 'i-j6cj8vyajp1fo4at0000' --BackupSnapshotList.1.VaultId 'v-0004vhwcs2pmacfz0000' --BackupSnapshotList.1.SnapshotId 's-000f9p6r5trm6u4d0000' --BackupSnapshotList.1.ClientId 'c-000a4h33w14ka8xa0000' --RetainLatestSnapshot true
